`create_model` computes `flat_snapshots` and converts the snapshots stored in `n.model.parameters`, but never converts `sns` itself before passing it to the variable and constraint builders. Thus, for a multi-period network with `"flat"` (or `"auto"` under v1 semantics), those builders still receive a MultiIndex; the component-data context does not change that argument.
